author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Agentic AI is more than just a tool.  During his keynote at the Open Source Summit Japan, Jim Zemlin, Executive Director of the Linux Foundation, explains why using smaller, specialized AI agents can lead to better results, greater trust and lower cost —especially when built on open source technology. 

Learn more about our agentic AI projects at https://hubs.la/Q040wy5Z0. 

🎥https://hubs.la/Q040wxTb0
title: Small Models, Big Results: Jim Zemlin on the Future of Agentic AI
